arStrings.szText:
{c_important}Death Trap's{/c} arm time is reduced by {c_number}[{SF_16}*100|%|]{/c}, and it deals a total of {c_number}{payload:TOOLTIP_UPGRADEA_DAMAGE}{/c} damage in the area.

Casting {c_important}Death Trap{/c} consumes {c_number}{SF_32}{/c} stack of {c_important}{u}Overpower{/u}{/c} to reduce arm time by {c_number}[{SF_16}*(1+{SF_33})*100|%|]{/c} and increase its damage by {c_number}[{SF_34}*100|x%|]{/c}.

{c_important}Death Trap{/c} Pulls In enemies and makes them {c_important}{u}Vulnerable{/u}{/c} and Knocked Down for {c_number}{SF_38}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Death Trap{/c} gains {c_number}{SF_36}{/c} additional charge and has its Cooldown reduced by {c_number}{SF_37}{/c} seconds.

{c_important}Death Trap{/c} is also a {c_important}Grenade{/c} Skill.

{c_important}Death Trap{/c} also releases {c_number}[{SF_41}*{SF_47}]{/c} {c_important}Stun Grenades{/c} that each explode for {c_number}{payload:UPGRADEC_DAMAGE_TOOLTIP}{/c} damage.
Killing an enemy or dealing damage to an Elite for the first time with {c_important}Death Trap{/c} reduces its Cooldown by {c_number}[SF_43]{/c} second.
Casting {c_important}Death Trap{/c} grants you {c_number}[{SF_48}*100|%|]{/c} Dodge Chance for {c_number}{SF_49}{/c} seconds.
{c_important}Death Trap's{/c} damage is increased by {c_number}[{SF_50}*100|%x|]{/c} while you have {c_important}{u}Resolve{/u}{/c}.
Enemies hit by {c_important}Death Trap{/c} take {c_number}[{SF_25}*100|%x|]{/c} increased damage from your {c_important}Trap{/c} Skills for {c_number}{buffduration:TRAP_DAMAGE_BONUS}{/c} seconds.
Enemies that resist {c_important}Death Trap's{/c} Pull In are hit again for {c_number}[SF_20*100|%x|]{/c} of {c_important}Death Trap's{/c} damage.
